summary: In this excerpt from Book 3, the narrator Morgan speaks with Dr. Hannah Klein about a baby obtained for adoption through an organization called Children of Light, which Hannah views skeptically. Hannah doubts the adoption was as easy as claimed, criticizes Dr. Alex Goddard, a doctor who is apparently now providing children for adoption, and calls his alternative medicine unproven. Morgan's pager then displays a number belonging to Lou Crenshaw, a security guard, who may be reporting news from Lenox Hill about Sarah, so Morgan leaves abruptly. Hannah gives Morgan a list of adoption agencies before the excerpt ends with Morgan aching for Steve.
one_line: Morgan questions Dr. Hannah Klein about the Children of Light adoption organization and Dr. Alex Goddard, then rushes off after a page about Sarah.
key_facts: Morgan says the adoption organization that got the baby is called Children of Light, which Morgan believes is up the Hudson somewhere, past the Cloisters.
Hannah Klein says the adoption story sounds impossible and suggests the child may have been kidnapped.
Morgan does not know how old the child was when the woman got him, only that he was a few weeks old, she thinks.
Hannah Klein describes Dr. Alex Goddard as one of those alternative-medicine types and says nobody knows the first thing about him.
Hannah Klein says Goddard's reported successes are anecdotal and likely the placebo effect.
Hannah Klein says she is not sure Goddard is board-certified.
Hannah Klein asks when Goddard started providing children for adoption, calling it peculiar.
Morgan's pager shows a number she knows well, which belongs to Lou Crenshaw, a security guard who had been off that day.
Morgan believes Lou Crenshaw would only page her with news from Lenox Hill, possibly about Sarah.
Morgan tells Hannah Klein it could be a medical emergency and leaves immediately.
Hannah Klein hands Morgan a list of adoption agencies, saying she has dealt with some of them through letters of reference for patients.
Hannah Klein squeezes Morgan's hand, the closest the two women have come to intimacy.
Morgan grasps the list and aches for Steve again.
